scope: Independent source/condition completeness and scientific-value challenge of the broader clinical FAPI packet, after single-cell source/value freeze.
budget: One bounded verification pass of five fixed sources plus one batched clarification if materially needed; no new source search.
question: Do original released rosters support the packet's counts, unresolved identities, condition/overlap handling and decision to keep the standalone EMC paper shelved?
strongest_alternative: Generic sarcoma/spindle/unknown labels may conceal relevant EMC observations; subtype absence in released metadata must not become a biological negative or a complete exclusion. Aggregate scan timing and reused donors cannot create an independent paired-EMC comparison.
check: Independently read original permitted clinical sources and compare all released categories/donor rows against exported tables; check totals, both imaging conditions, actual access status and cohort overlap; bind the final review to exact artifact hashes.
stop: No new authenticated EMC measurement: support shelving with explicit gaps. A genuine identity/count/coverage discrepancy: report the smallest correction and verify the changed dependencies once.
restrictions: Read-only other writer sources, own review path only, no copies of bulky originals, no paid/GPU/outreach/publication/PR/external changes. Exclude interrupted FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA-review tasks. Quiet file/API checks only; retain source cache ownership, at least10GiB free and total owned packet below64MiB including copies.
